title: ranunculus bellicrenatus
intro: Ranunculus bellicrenatus, commonly known as the creeping buttercup, is a perennial plant in the family Ranunculaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antibacterial properties. The bioactive constituents of Ranunculus bellicrenatus include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as reducing pain and inflammation, and promoting wound healing. Additionally, its therapeutic actions include antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-cancer properties, making it a valuable plant for various medicinal applications.
